description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelTopComposeEmailButton, a widget for rendering a 'Compose Email' button in the subpanel of the SuiteCRM application, specifically for the SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton hierarchy. It includes methods for generating the widget ID, rendering the button with appropriate email link or compose modal, and handling user permissions and email client differences.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopComposeEmailButton
classes.description: A widget class providing a 'Compose Email' button for subpanels within SuiteCRM, with support for user permissions, email client variations, and contextual email composition.

methods.name: getWidgetId
methods.description: Returns a unique widget ID, setting the button label from language strings.

methods.name: _get_form
methods.description: Generates HTML for the email compose button, considering user permissions, email client, and the focus bean's email address.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the button on the screen, including a disabled state for unauthorised users or incompatible clients.
